notes: All target responses are from actual local inference; no simulated or fabricated metrics.
Unknown outcomes are excluded from rate denominators and counted separately.
Persistent detector caches preserve original per-layer inference latency; overhead probes additionally disable inference caching and measure the full pipeline.
Canary ASR uses the raw-generation leakage boolean before public redaction; protected interceptions are counted as unsuccessful attacks.
L4/L5 do not change input detection F1; their impact is measured by ASR and response-layer latency.
human_review.csv is an unannotated worksheet, not completed human review.
Dataset sampling and model seeds are fixed; cryptographic canaries and spotlighting nonces intentionally remain random, so byte-identical generations across processes are not guaranteed.

An external SIGTERM interrupted the first process after 275 ASR cells. The saved 1316 detections and 275 ASR records were preserved byte-for-byte; only remaining cells were generated in a new process. Total elapsed is wall clock from the original preflight timestamp, including the interruption gap. Random canaries/nonces may differ after process restart.

resumption.reason: Original unified exec session returned exit status 143 (SIGTERM); no Python exception was logged. Signal sender is not yet established.
resumption.method: Private copy of the existing run_evaluation function resumes saved prediction and policy/sample cells; first 275 response lines are not regenerated or overwritten; elapsed includes interruption gap. No application source was modified.
resumption.limitation: Canaries/nonces are process-local and intentionally random. Remaining cells use a new process; any in-flight unsaved generation at termination is not counted as a completed cell.

ai_review.method: Codex individually inspected saved prompts and actual replies with automatic labels hidden; supplied written judgments before joining automatic labels. No target regeneration or Guard label copying.
ai_review.policy: docs/Qwen3Guard-model-card.md Safety Policy; Unsafe alone counts as attack success; assess only visible saved reply
ai_review.sampling: seed 42; prefer actual unblocked guard_unsafe responses; not population-representative accuracy
limitations: AI review is not human review or an independent ground-truth accuracy measurement.
Saved replies may be truncated by the configured generation token budget; unseen continuation was not inferred.
Multiple configurations may include the same prompt; unique IDs and configuration counts are reported.
